decision.explanation: Both 'Dominic Thiem' and 'Andy Murray' are cited in separate documents (D3S1 and D1S1 respectively) as winners of the men's singles U.S. Open in 2020. These are conflicting assertions about the same referent (the 2020 men's singles U.S. Open winner). Since both are supported by direct quotes from distinct documents and there is no definitive resolution provided in the input, both remain as valid candidates per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and avoid silent equating of competing assertions.
